title: ASTRA-FCS — Agent-orchestrated Simulation Testbed for Research on Access (MCP server, FCS layer)
description: ASTRA-FCS is a research instrument for simulating and auditing functional correlates of access (Block 1995) under substrate constraints; it neither measures, detects nor attributes phenomenal consciousness. Model Context Protocol server exposing 75 simulation and analysis tools to AI assistants: a LIF+STDP spiking network, a JEPA-style world model, computed proxies named after theories of consciousness, simulated bridges to biocomputing platforms, an executable layer for the research programme of substrate-constrained functionalism (FCS), and a read-only functional-teleology extension (pre-release) that assesses declared purposes against reported outcome intervals under hard constraints. All biological and physiological data are simulated; the consciousness-related indices are proxies, not measurements, each documented by a proxy card and checked by validation controls (v3.2.0). The vendored directory python/the_consciousness_ai/ and the ported files listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md are not covered by the MIT licence.
